title: Studying the thermodynamic, hydrogen storage, structural, optoelectronic and mechanical attributes of the alkali metal-based (Li/Na/K/Rb/Cs)CH6 perovskite hydrides for renewable energy applications
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00249H, Paper
Hudabia Murtaza, Quratul Ain, Junaid Munir, Hamid M. Ghaithan, Abdullah Ahmed Ali Ahmed, Saif M. H. Qaid, Abdullah S. Aldwayyan
This study provides the electronic, structural, mechanical, hydrogen storage and optical properties of (Li/Na/K/Rb/Cs)CH6 using density functional theory employing the WIEN2k code. The GGA and mBJ potentials are used for the calculations.
